output.title: ACME certificate profile selection is a new opt-in capability
output.content: The change lets users select ACME certificate profiles from their ACME CA, such as `tlsserver` or `shortlived`. It is described as a new capability, not a changed default. The environment shows no ACME issuer, and the installed CRDs listed are only certificates.cert-manager.io (CRD dimension is absent). It would matter only if the operator chooses to request a profile.
